title: Extract the invoice pricing module
issue: `src/invoice.js` has become responsible for line validation, subtotals, bulk discounts, tax, and invoice totals. Extract those pricing calculations into a new `src/pricing.js` module. Keep `src/invoice.js`'s existing named exports and behavior unchanged: callers must not need to change imports, discounting must still happen at the same threshold, and monetary values must keep their existing integer-cent rounding and validation rules.
expectedBehavior: The pricing calculations live in src/pricing.js, src/invoice.js preserves its public API, and invoice subtotals, discounts, tax, totals, empty inputs, rounding, and validation behave exactly as before.
